title: Color applications / offer and connection
slide_intent: Show color continuity across different layouts so the brand survives changing content.
strategic_value: Repeated red identification can connect DB product advertising with a broader connection message.
demonstration: A BahnCard offer on white sits beside a wide light/dark composition reading Wir verbinden / Was bewegt with rail imagery and sleepers.
practical_value: Compare how red works as product emphasis, logo and edge motif across two applications.

content_islands.name: Product offer
content_islands.spec: Place the tilted BahnCard and bold black headline in the left light panel.

content_islands.name: Connection composition
content_islands.spec: Pair dark text/image space with a white message panel and a red lower sleeper at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples use the palette in product advertising and a connection-themed layout.
